loop_primitives.evidence_quote: All agents in TradingAgents follow the ReAct prompting framework (Yao et al., 2023), which synergizes reasoning and acting.

multi_agent_topology.note: Fixed hand-off sequence of specialised agents including debate stages (bull/bear, risk debaters with facilitator); debate is a sub-stage.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: By utilizing structured reports, agents can query necessary details directly from the global state
delegation_mechanism.note: Control passes between role nodes sharing a global LangGraph state.

human_in_loop.note: CLI selects inputs up front; no evidence of in-run approval, but run loop/CLI code not shown.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: By clearly defining each agent’s state, we ensure that each role only extracts or queries the necessary information, processes it, and returns a completed report.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Each completed run appends its decision to `~/.tradingagents/memory/trading_memory.md`.
long_term_memory.note: Reflections injected into Portfolio Manager prompt; see tradingagents/agents/utils/memory.py get_past_context.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: When enabled, LangGraph saves state after each node so a crashed or interrupted run resumes from the last successful step instead of starting over.
state_persistence.note: Opt-in (checkpoint_enabled False by default in default_config.py); per-node checkpoint reload rather than conversation resume.

self_verification.note: Debate/manager judging is part of the pipeline; market_data_validator.py exists but not shown.

retry_policy.note: Only LLM transport retries configurable; no task-level retry evidenced. Run loop not shown.

termination_condition.note: Pipeline ends at Portfolio Manager decision; debate rounds capped by max_debate_rounds/max_risk_discuss_rounds; max_tokens here is per-call output cap, not run-ending.

cost_controls.note: Quick/deep model split is fixed per role, not routing; max_tokens is per-call output cap.

execution_isolation.note: Actions are in-process Python data-fetch calls; Docker option is for the whole app, not action isolation.
